mapper.select: select count(*) from assignment ass where ass.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and ass.assignment_status = '게시' and ( ass.assignment_due_date is null or ass.assignment_due_date > systimestamp )

select * from ( select ass.assignment_no, ass.course_no, c.course_title, ass.assignment_title,
case when ass.assignment_status = '마감' or ( ass.assignment_due_date is not null and systimestamp >= ass.assignment_due_date ) then '마감' else '제출가능' end as assignment_phase,
ass.assignment_due_date
from assignment ass
join course c on ass.course_no = c.course_no
where ass.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and ass.assignment_status = '게시' and ( ass.assignment_due_date is null or ass.assignment_due_date > systimestamp )
order by ass.assignment_due_date asc nulls last, ass.assignment_no desc )
where rownum <= 5
select count(*) from exam e where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp >= e.exam_start and systimestamp < e.exam_end
select count(*) from exam e where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp < e.exam_start

select * from ( select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.exam_title,
case when e.exam_status = '마감' or systimestamp >= e.exam_end then '종료'
when systimestamp < e.exam_start then '예정'
else '응시가능' end as exam_phase,
e.exam_start, e.exam_end
from exam e
join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no
where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and e.exam_status = '공개' and e.exam_end > systimestamp
order by e.exam_start asc, e.exam_no asc )
where rownum <= 5

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule s JOIN course c ON s.course_no = c.course_no WHERE s.schedule_week = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AND c.course_status IN ('모집중', '진행중') AND c.employee_no = #{employeeNo}

select * from ( select c.course_no AS courseNo, c.course_title AS courseTitle, c.course_subject AS courseSubject, g.grade_level AS gradeLevel, NVL(act.account_name, '미지정') AS tutorName, s.schedule_start || ' ~ ' || s.schedule_end AS scheduleInfo, NVL(cs.classroom_no, s.classroom_no) || '호' AS classroomInfo, s.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, s.schedule_start AS scheduleStart, s.schedule_end AS scheduleEnd, NVL(cs.classroom_no, s.classroom_no) AS classroomNo, cs.session_no AS sessionNo, cs.session_status AS sessionStatus, c.course_current_count AS courseCurrentCount, c.course_limit AS courseLimit from schedule s join course c on s.course_no = c.course_no LEFT JOIN grade g ON c.grade_no = g.grade_no left join employee e on c.employee_no = e.employee_no left join account act ON e.account_no = act.account_no left join class_session cs on s.schedule_no = cs.schedule_no and TRUNC(CAST(cs.session_start AS DATE)) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHERE s.schedule_week = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') and c.course_status in ('모집중', '진행중') and c.employee_no = #{employeeNo} order by s.schedule_start asc )

select * from ( select ass.assignment_no, ass.course_no, c.course_title, ass.assignment_title,
case when ass.assignment_status = '마감' or ( ass.assignment_due_date is not null and systimestamp >= ass.assignment_due_date ) then '마감' else '제출가능' end as assignment_phase,
ass.assignment_due_date
from assignment ass
join course c on ass.course_no = c.course_no
where ass.assignment_status = '게시' and ( ass.assignment_due_date is null or ass.assignment_due_date > systimestamp )
order by ass.assignment_due_date asc nulls last, ass.assignment_no desc )
where rownum <= 5
select count(*) from exam e where e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp >= e.exam_start and systimestamp < e.exam_end
select count(*) from exam e where e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp < e.exam_start

select * from ( select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.exam_title,
case when e.exam_status = '마감' or systimestamp >= e.exam_end then '종료'
when systimestamp < e.exam_start then '예정'
else '응시가능' end as exam_phase,
e.exam_start, e.exam_end
from exam e
join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no
where e.exam_status = '공개' and e.exam_end > systimestamp
order by case when systimestamp >= e.exam_start and systimestamp < e.exam_end then 1 else 2 end, e.exam_start asc, e.exam_no asc )
where rownum <= 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule s JOIN course c ON s.course_no = c.course_no WHERE s.schedule_week = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AND c.course_status IN ('모집중', '진행중')

select * from ( select c.course_no AS courseNo, c.course_title AS courseTitle, c.course_subject AS courseSubject, g.grade_level AS gradeLevel, NVL(act.account_name, '미지정') AS tutorName, s.schedule_start || ' ~ ' || s.schedule_end AS scheduleInfo, NVL(cs.classroom_no, s.classroom_no) || '호' AS classroomInfo, s.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, s.schedule_start AS scheduleStart, s.schedule_end AS scheduleEnd, NVL(cs.classroom_no, s.classroom_no) AS classroomNo, cs.session_no AS sessionNo, cs.session_status AS sessionStatus, c.course_current_count AS courseCurrentCount, c.course_limit AS courseLimit from schedule s join course c on s.course_no = c.course_no LEFT JOIN grade g ON c.grade_no = g.grade_no left join employee e on c.employee_no = e.employee_no left join account act ON e.account_no = act.account_no left join class_session cs on s.schedule_no = cs.schedule_no and TRUNC(CAST(cs.session_start AS DATE)) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHERE s.schedule_week = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') and c.course_status in ('모집중', '진행중') order by s.schedule_start asc )

select P.payment_no as paymentNo, S.student_no as studentNo, A.account_name as studentName, P.payment_month as paymentMonth,
-- 총 청구액 - 결제완료된 금액 = 실제 미납액 (P.payment_amount - NVL(( select sum(payment_history_amount) from payment_history where payment_no = P.payment_no and payment_history_status = '결제완료' ), 0)) as remainingAmount
from payment P inner join student S on P.student_no = S.student_no inner join account A on S.account_no = A.account_no where P.payment_status in ('미납', '부분납')
-- 이번 달(현재 DB 시간 기준 YYYY-MM) 데이터는 제외 and P.payment_month != to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM')
-- 월 기준 오름차순(오래된 것부터) 정렬 order by P.payment_month asc, P.payment_no asc
